selector.rationale: Mycosis Fungoides best explains the findings due to the presence of atypical lymphocytes, perifollicular lymphocytic infiltrates, and a high CD4 to CD8 ratio, along with monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement, which are all characteristic of this condition.

rejected.label: Follicular Mucinosis
rejected.why: While follicular mucin deposition is noted, the presence of atypical lymphocytes and monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement points more strongly towards a lymphoma diagnosis.

rejected.label: Cutaneous Pseudolymphoma
rejected.why: The lack of strong evidence supporting pseudolymphoma, combined with the presence of monoclonal T-cell gene rearrangement, makes this diagnosis less likely.
